headline: Cristiano Ronaldo provisionally suspended by Portugal after team walkout
summary: The Portuguese Football Federation has opened disciplinary proceedings against the 41-year-old star after he left the national squad.
details: The Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) has provisionally suspended Cristiano Ronaldo following his decision to walk out on the national team.
The federation classified the case as 'urgent' and confirmed that disciplinary proceedings have been initiated against the 41-year-old attacker.
The conflict began when Ronaldo was made to warm up as a substitute against Norway on September 27 and was not brought on, followed by not starting against Denmark on October 1.
Ronaldo later accused coach Jorge Jesus of breaking his word regarding game time in Nations League matches, though he apologized to supporters earlier this week.
Despite the suspension, Ronaldo stated he is not retiring from international duty and will be available to compete for Portugal once any punishment is served.
Meanwhile, the star has returned to club action with Saudi Arabian side Al-Nassr, scoring in a 3-0 victory against Diriyah in the Saudi Pro League.
caption:
Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended by the Portuguese Football Federation after walking out on his national team.

The Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) has provisionally suspended Cristiano Ronaldo following his decision to walk out on the national team.

The federation classified the case as 'urgent' and confirmed that disciplinary proceedings have been initiated against the 41-year-old attacker.

The conflict began when Ronaldo was made to warm up as a substitute against Norway on September 27 and was not brought on, followed by not starting against Denmark on October 1.

Ronaldo later accused coach Jorge Jesus of breaking his word regarding game time in Nations League matches, though he apologized to supporters earlier this week.

Despite the suspension, Ronaldo stated he is not retiring from international duty and will be available to compete for Portugal once any punishment is served.

Meanwhile, the star has returned to club action with Saudi Arabian side Al-Nassr, scoring in a 3-0 victory against Diriyah in the Saudi Pro League.

headline: DSCC launches special cleaning drive in 75 wards to fight dengue
summary: Administrator Md. Abdus Salam urges residents to keep their surroundings clean and remove stagnant water to reduce the risk of dengue.
details: The Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) conducted a simultaneous special cleaning drive across all 75 of its wards on Saturday. This operation is part of a broader 'Cleaning Day' program held every Saturday.
caption:
75 wards, one goal: cleaning Dhaka South to stop dengue. 🦟

The Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) conducted a simultaneous special cleaning drive across all 75 of its wards on Saturday. This operation is part of a broader 'Cleaning Day' program held every Saturday.
